references.text: The Lord's Spirit came upon Othniel, and he became a judge in Israel. This shows the same pattern where God's Spirit equips a person for service.
The Lord's Spirit came upon Gideon and gave him strength to lead Israel. The same expression of the Spirit's empowerment as with Samson.
The Lord's Spirit came upon Jephthah. Another example of how the Spirit equipped the judges in Israel.
The Lord's Spirit came upon Samson with power. A continuation of how the Spirit worked in Samson's life after it began to drive him.
The Lord's Spirit came upon Samson again. It repeatedly shows how the Spirit gave Samson supernatural strength.
The Lord's Spirit came mightily upon Samson. Another example of the Spirit's power in Samson's life.
God's Spirit came upon Saul, and he prophesied. This shows the same pattern where the Spirit takes hold of a person for a special service.
God's Spirit came upon Saul when he heard about the threats against Jabesh. The Spirit equipped him to lead Israel in battle.
The Danites sent spies from Zorah and Eshtaol. The same geographical area mentioned in connection with Samson's early life.
Samson was buried between Zorah and Eshtaol. The same place where the Spirit first began to drive him.
